analysis: Documentation-only change: docs/operations/provider-release.md (head lines 632-636) adds a release-lane step where scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py refuses any built binary importing Foundation's back-deployed Date.>= or Date.<=. The docs/threat-model.yaml hunk (head lines 41-48) adds a comment recording that the App Attest key-generation budget, enrollment resume, stall restart and key-history checks now use timeIntervalSince(_:). Per the comment, thresholds and results are unchanged and the fix addresses a crash loop (A-018 availability). No code, workflow, trust boundary, authorization, attestation, encryption or secret handling is changed in the supplied evidence. The new gate is a build-time availability and quality control and does not weaken signing, notarization, registration or qualification steps (T-054, TB-011). The threat-model comment does not alter any threat entry and says it does not revalidate older entries. The rest of the release doc appears to be unchanged surrounding text. I did not see the script, the Swift source changes or the build.md anchor, so the claim that the Date comparisons were actually replaced and that the weak-import check is enforced rests on documentation only. A later pass could confirm the script and the Swift changes if they appear in another batch. This is not a security regression and I report no findings.
